title: Chapter 29
text:
The two were brought to a room by Raccoon's men. Ma Jie looked nervous and asked, "What do you need me to do?"

It's not a bad thing. That guy is a machinist and knows how to make guns. Our boss has been wanting to kill him for a while now, but he didn't know anything about him, so he didn't do anything rashly.

Ma Jie's mind was suddenly filled with excitement. It was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to meet Raccoon Boss. Perhaps he would be able to make a meteoric rise in his career and escape his fate of being alone. He glanced at his yellow-haired cousin with an envious expression on his face.

There was no need to hesitate to betray Han Xiao. He was not related to him, so why should he care?

After waiting for half an hour, Raccoon finally walked in. Ma Jie and Ma Jie hurriedly bowed to him. Ma Jie was in such a hurry that he accidentally knocked over a chair.

"You know who Technician Han is?"

Civet's expressionless face made Ma Jie even more nervous. Beads of sweat formed on his forehead.

"His name is Han Xiao. He's a rogue. He snuck in with me. This is his first time in the Western Capital. He's not related to anyone."

"That's all?" asked Raccoon.

Ma Jie thought that Raccoon was not satisfied, so he quickly added, "By the way, he didn't bring anything with him when he entered the Western Capital. He was dressed in rags and looked penniless."

"Very good."

Raccoon turned around and was about to leave.

"As long as you're satisfied, boss," said Ma Jie respectfully.

Raccoon paused and smiled. "You're not bad. Follow me from now on."

Ma Jie's eyes widened. He was overjoyed.

I'm rich!

After Raccoon left, Ma Jie hurriedly stepped forward and said, "Ma Jie, I'll need your help in the future."

This time, it was Ma Jie's turn to be confident. He glanced at Ma Jie and said, "What did you call me just now?"

"Cou … cousin."

Ma Jie and Ma Jie's roles were reversed. Their expressions were natural and unashamed.

Ma Jie's vanity was satisfied. He patted Ma Jie's shoulder and smiled. After thinking for a while, he asked one of Raccoon's men, "Bro, may I ask you something? How will our boss deal with Han Xiao?"

"That goes without saying. Of course, we'll capture him and torture him to force him to write down the blueprint of the gun. With the blueprint, we'll be able to train our own gunsmiths and then kill him."

"That's good." Ma Jie was relieved.

…

Less than three minutes later, Raccoon returned to the table. He glanced at the untouched dishes and said with a fake smile, "Han Xiao, you're right, right?"

"Looks like you know my name now."

Han Xiao smelled the impending storm, but his expression did not change. He quietly put his hand into his backpack and felt for the socket of the Lightweight Mechanical Arm. With a click, the arm tightened, and it could be activated at any time. Only then did he feel slightly relieved. Although he came to Krow's Junk Shop to scam the raccoon, he was used to being careful. There was a lesson to be learned. When he first came into Galaxy, Han Xiao was still a hothead. He treated NPCs like those rigid programs in other games and did whatever he wanted. He had failed miserably more than a dozen times. Even a pig knew to be careful.

How exactly did he fail? Han Xiao could tolerate being hunted down by players at his respawn point, but to be hunted down by NPCs for three days …

Stop right there. Even those who talk about dark history need to be pulled out of the room!

Raccoon tapped his fingers on the table and said slowly, "Hehe, I've been trying to guess who you are, but I didn't expect you to be a wanderer who just came to the Western Capital not long ago. I have to say, you're very cautious. I only found out about you today."

"So?"

Raccoon's face turned cold. He changed his attitude faster than flipping a book. "Be smart and hand over all the detailed gun manufacturing techniques."

Knowing that Han Xiao was alone and had no one to rely on, Raccoon finally decided to make his move. He tore off his mask of fake friendliness and revealed the fangs hidden under his smiling face.

"You don't want to be my friend at all?"

"What kind of friendship do I have with you? We're just making a deal. "

"You're not afraid that I'll kill you?"

Han Xiao grinned.

Raccoon snapped his fingers, and the four men beside him took out their pistols and pointed them at Han Xiao.

"Do you think I didn't make any preparations? How ironic. These guns that are pointed at you now are all made by you."

There were a total of six armed men. Across the table was Raccoon and four of his men. Behind him were two people guarding the door. In this narrow room, Han Xiao had limited space to dodge.

Han Xiao did not move and said slowly, "Even if I hand over the technology, you'll still kill me."

Raccoon sneered. That was what he thought. Only a few people had things that were valuable, and he knew the principle of cutting the weeds and eliminating the roots.

"I hope you can cooperate. At least you can avoid some physical pain."

"What if I don't cooperate?"

"Some of my men are very good at interrogation. You'll talk sooner or later."

Han Xiao suddenly put away the laziness on his face. His sharp eyes made Raccoon tremble.

"You think I have no way to escape?"

Raccoon noticed that Han Xiao's left hand kept reaching into the backpack. He shook his head and said, "Maybe you have something in the backpack that you can rely on. But if you do anything, my men will shoot."

"What if I tell you that the backpack is filled with high explosives?"

The backpack was only opened a crack, so no one could see what was inside.

Raccoon sneered. He did not believe this bullsh * t. Ma Jie's appearance was purely an accident. Han Xiao could not have prepared in advance. Who was he kidding?

Han Xiao said slowly, "I don't know who told you about me, but obviously, that person doesn't know much about me. You can try turning on your computer and entering the dark web to look for the latest bounty."

Raccoon frowned. Han Xiao's fearless look made his heart beat faster.

Although he had some power in the Western Capital, he was just a small local in the entire underground world. He was not qualified to be involved in the dark web, so he did not pay much attention to the dark web and did not know about the Germinal Organization's bounty.

Raccoon felt that this was Han Xiao's trick to buy time. Furthermore, he was the boss. If he did what someone told him to do, wouldn't it be embarrassing?

Han Xiao said calmly, "If you don't believe me, do you want to take a gamble? Life is always full of surprises. Explosives can do the most damage in a limited space like this. First, there will be an explosion. The shrapnel will shoot out along with the shockwave and cover every corner. Then, there will be a high-temperature flame that will set the house on fire. Everyone here will be burned. But don't worry, you won't be burned to death because you have been dismembered by the first round of explosion … "

Raccoon's men could not help but take a step back. Han Xiao's words scared them.

Raccoon shouted, "Enough, I'm not interested in joking with you. Stand up, or I'll get someone to shoot."

Han Xiao shrugged and sighed. "Can't we talk about this? I'll give you the map …"

At this moment, the last rays of the sun sank into the horizon, and night dominated the sky.

Before he could finish his sentence, Han Xiao suddenly exploded! His left hand clenched into a fist, and his mechanical arm was like a beast waking up from a deep sleep. His backpack was torn into pieces, and he lifted the table in front of him. The pots and pans in front of him were thrown at Raccoon and the four men.

Talk? No way, you don't believe me, do you?

With four people in front and two behind, Han Xiao made a decision. He flipped the table to block the firepower in front of him, forming a temporary barrier in front of him. Then, he turned around and rushed to the door with his mechanical arm in front of him. He looked ferocious, like a charging cavalry.

Clang, clang, clang! The table knocked over the four men.

Raccoon's forehead was bleeding from the plate. He covered his wound and roared, "Open fire!"

At this time, only the two men at the door could shoot.
